research_scope: Demon Flash Strike — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

verification_audit.classification_finding: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference classifies Demon Flash Strike as a Strike Super and Counter Skill. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Parallel Quest 160 — Pan in Peril, Hero of Justice Pack 2.
verification_audit.availability_finding: As a PQ skill reward it is obtainable by the Future Warrior; usable_by_cac true.
verification_audit.finish_policy: The all-186 PQ guide explicitly lists Demon Flash Strike under PQ160 Basic Reward, so ultimate_finish_required is false.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The user holds a brief counter stance. If struck by a melee attack, including basic attacks, Strike Supers, Ultimates, or grabs, the counter launches a kick. An additional input teleports to the opponent and performs a punch into a blue Ki Blast follow-up. The current reference reports approximately 25% counter damage and 20% ranged follow-up damage.

records.name: Demon Flash Strike
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide explicitly lists Demon Flash Strike under PQ160 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Strike a pose that stops the opponent's melee attack; when hit, counter with a powerful kick. Additional input moves in front of the opponent to attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Counter activates against melee attacks including Normal, Supers, Ultimates and Grabs. The counter kick is documented at approximately 25% damage. Additional input teleports to the opponent, lands a punch that stuns, then slams a blue Ki Blast onto them for approximately 20% damage.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ160 is part of Hero of Justice Pack 2 content.
records.pve_notes: No unsupported drop probability was added because the available guide establishes the skill as a Basic Reward but not a percentage chance.
records.pvp_notes: The current skill page documents a historical Ver. 1.21.00 counter behavior issue; exact current frame data is not recorded.
